pictures.name: MR1-Gold-Rain
pictures.prompt: A sunlit marble palace courtyard in ancient India. In the middle stands King Mandhata (a tall, handsome ancient Indian king with a short black beard, a tall gold crown, a crimson and gold silk robe, restless dark eyes), his hands just touched together, face lifted, as a glittering rain of jewels and gold coins falls from a clear sky around him, piling knee-deep at his feet. Courtiers stare in wonder. Golden light, deep blue shadows under the arches. Contemplative sacred oil painting, one tall 9:16 picture, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow quiet mood, main subject in the middle of the frame.
